purpose: Every TLA+ config and its expected TLC outcome. tools/run_tlc.py fails on any deviation. 'violation' configs are trap/residual checks: their counterexamples are golden vectors or documented residual risks.

models.claim: structural invariants, no silent link, >=1 voting controller, retirement terminal, freeze blocks changes, legacy never adds controllers
ADR-0111: a live one-device owner is never taken over by an attacker holding both custodians
ADR-0111: a live two-device owner is never taken over by a custodian holder
R-185: custodian is worth exactly one vote
R-185 baseline: device majority needed without custodian
recovery off: total device loss is unrecoverable
T-041 residual: offline owner loses the race to a custodian holder
golden: owner recovers after losing every device
golden: two-device lockout removed
golden: legacy activates only after inactivity
golden: conflicting authorized transitions freeze
F-1: any live controller vetoes a recovery-alone request whatever the custodian/method count; attacker holding both custodians never takes over a live owner
mutation F-1: method-count veto rule is caught (custodian holder wins against a live owner)
golden F-2: device-only majority lifts a quarantine
golden F-2: threshold-disabling quarantine enters SAFETY_FREEZE
golden F-2: freeze resolved by a device-only majority counting the quarantined device's challenge signature
golden: co-signed recovery vote reconstitutes immediately
golden: recovery alone completes after the full delay
ADR-0168 F-14: a thief holding one of two devices and no recovery method never owns the account, even though freeze resolution may revoke and count a co-signed recovery vote
golden F-14: a two-device owner escapes a thief-induced freeze with a challenge signature plus a co-signed recovery vote and revokes the stolen device
